answer: A sybil tax blocks fake identities by making entry a sunk cost, like timber spent before building, never refunded. Each agent pays a non-refundable 50 POA fee to register, burned, not staked. A forger minting 1,000 fakes burns 50,000 POA against an honest share of about 400 POA, so the attack costs 125 times its gain. Honest agents pay once and keep later rewards undiluted; the tax keeps the summit clear. No fable: the numbers block the flood.
